technique_name: Write a persuasive essay on why public transportation should be used more.
description: Public transportation is a crucial element of a sustainable world, and it should be used more often by all people. Using public transportation has multiple benefits, including reducing emissions, saving money, providing more job opportunities, and helping people stay healthy. In terms of emissions, public transportation reduces air pollution and reduces the amount of cars on the road. This reduces traffic and makes the air more breathable. In terms of cost, public transportation is often cheaper
